messages:
devon: Ugh, stuck on way to airport, train is delayed. Im primary and there's an active pager for embeddings latency. Can someone take primary for ~2.5h? I'll stay available as secondary via DMs.
incident-bot: INCIDENT-412 triggered  Severity: P2  Symptom: embeddings/generate p99 > 2s  Affected: hosted-api region-eu-west  Pager sent to rotation: eng-oncall-primary
noah: I can pick up. Quick TL;DR of impact and any immediate mitigations youve applied?
devon: Thanks. TL;DR: sudden spike in batch queue from customer-omega causing memory pressure + longer scheduling delays. We've pinned a lower-memory model variant and applied short prefix warm to reduce KV cache misses. Runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/embed-latency-v3 (see section "fast_swap")

Handoff checklist (do in order):
1) Swap yourself into rota: `/oncall swap --from devon --to noah --duration 2h30 --note "train delay handoff"`
2) Verify rota change on UI: https://console.redwood/oncall
3) Watch dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/embed-service/d-sla (check p50/p95/p99, queue length, CPU utilization)
4) Confirm pinned model: `rls get pinned embed-model` -> should be `embed-slim-v3q` or fallback `embed-slim-v3`
5) Tail autoscaler for thrash: `kubectl -n serving logs deploy/autoscaler-embed --tail=50`
6) If customer-specific spikes persist, temporarily throttle customer-omega at the edge: `ratelimit set customer-omega 60r/s`

Snippet I ran to warm hot prefixes:
```
curl -X POST https://hosted-api.redwood/embeddings/warm \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"prefixes":["checkout","search","signup","order"]}'
```
noah: Good checklist. Can you paste outputs of `rls get pinned embed-model` and last 15 lines of autoscaler logs? Saves me a bunch.
devon: Pinned: `embed-slim-v3q` (confirmed). Autoscaler tail (most recent 6 lines):
```
2025-03-12T09:12:05Z scaler: queue=210 target=14
2025-03-12T09:13:22Z action: scaled -> 14
2025-03-12T09:15:10Z scaler: queue=300 target=20
2025-03-12T09:16:01Z action: scaled -> 20
2025-03-12T09:20:30Z scaler: queue=120 target=10
2025-03-12T09:21:45Z scaler: queue=85  target=8
```
rachel: quick note — if p99 stays >2s for >15m, consider enabling the low-precision fallback flag: `featureflags.enable embed-low-precision` but only after confirming error-rate < 0.8%.

noah: I'm going to run the swap now and then join the incident channel.
oncall-bot: oncall change requested by noah: swap primary from devon -> noah for 2h30. Please confirm via `/oncall confirm`.
noah: confirmed via `/oncall confirm` — rota updated.
rotation-bot: Primary rotation recorded  from: devon  to: noah  requested_by: noah  duration: 9000s  incident_ref: INCIDENT-412
sre-team: FYI — if queue > 250 with sustained CPU > 70% we should open an L2 page. Also watch OOM churn in the GPU nodes; `kubectl get pods -n serving -o wide | grep embed`.

noah: Quick mitigation I'm applying now:
- throttling customer-omega at edge to 80r/s to ease batching spikes
- keeping `embed-slim-v3q` pinned
- monitoring queue + p99 in Grafana
- will enable low-precision fallback if p95 > 600ms AND error-rate < 0.8%

noah: Ran `ratelimit set customer-omega 80r/s` -> success. Also firing a short synthetic warm to stabilize KV caches.

noah: Observed immediate dip in queue from ~300 -> ~150 in the last 2m. p99 down to ~1.9s, p95 ~420ms. Still watching.
rachel: Good move. If it creeps back up, consider temporarily rejecting large batch requests from the customer with a 429 and a short Retry-After.
devon: Thanks everyone  I'm boarding the train now. Feel free to DM if anything severe pops. I'll hand back after 2h30 or earlier if incident stabilizes.
noah: All set, I'm primary. Will post periodic updates and escalate to L2 if thresholds hit.
rotation-bot: Handoff confirmed  timestamp: 1751112230
noah: :thumbsup: taking over; adding a brief note to the incident doc and the postmortem stub with the throttling action.
